lines.text: At Eden's Repair Center...
Cecil and Papillon silently survey the interior of the repair center.
There are two giant machines that create Nikkes,
three brain shelters,
and Rose, lying there completely motionless.
After looking around the quiet repair center for a long while, Papillon finally speaks.

lines.speaker: papillon
lines.text: This place is practically a morgue.

lines.speaker: cecil
lines.text: A real morgue wouldn't be much different from this.
Cecil stares at the brain shelters resting in front of her.
She picks one of them up.
Rapunzel's tag is attached to it.
She hands it over to Papillon.

lines.speaker: cecil
lines.text: Put this in the body maker.

lines.speaker: papillon
lines.text: Okay. Time to revive her.

lines.speaker: cecil
lines.text: Rapunzel, at least.

lines.speaker: papillon
lines.text: ... Is Scarlet beyond saving?

lines.speaker: cecil
lines.text: It's not going to be easy.

lines.speaker: cecil
lines.text: If I'd known it would come to this, I would have secured the body data for the previous Scarlet.

lines.speaker: papillon
lines.text: She wouldn't have let you. I heard you two didn't get along.

lines.speaker: cecil
lines.text: That's true. Still, I could have at least tried asking.

lines.speaker: cecil
lines.text: Perhaps I should have gotten on my knees, or begged.

lines.speaker: cecil
lines.text: Pride, differences of opinions... It all feels so unimportant now.

lines.speaker: cecil
lines.text: Lately, all I have is regret.

lines.speaker: papillon
lines.text: I don't regret anything.

lines.speaker: cecil
lines.text: I'm talking about myself right now.

lines.speaker: papillon
lines.text: Joining the Counters to play spy. Getting taken hostage by Eden.

lines.speaker: papillon
lines.text: ... Starting to flee to the Ark, then turning back.

lines.speaker: papillon
lines.text: Deciding to settle down and stay in Eden.

lines.speaker: papillon
lines.text: Inheriting you-know-what.

lines.speaker: papillon
lines.text: I don't regret a single thing.

lines.speaker: papillon
lines.text: Even if I could turn back time, I would make the exact same choices again.

lines.speaker: papillon
lines.text: Our decisions change naturally as we make our way through life.

lines.speaker: papillon
lines.text: I always made the best choices for who I was at the time.

lines.speaker: papillon
lines.text: I'm sure you did too.

lines.speaker: cecil
lines.text: How convenient. Are you sure you're not just reframing everything to make yourself feel good?

lines.speaker: papillon
lines.text: The first thing a spy has to learn is to adapt to change.

lines.speaker: papillon
lines.text: When you get tossed back and forth so much, the only way to survive is to become more elastic and go with the flow.
Papillon inserts Rapunzel's brain shelter into the huge machine.
A loud mechanical hum fills the room.

lines.speaker: papillon
lines.text: ... Is that all I have to do?

lines.speaker: cecil
lines.text: Yes. I've already input all the body data. The machine will take care of the rest.

lines.speaker: papillon
lines.text: ... I don't want to watch. I feel like I'd have a Mind Switch if I did.

lines.speaker: papillon
lines.text: I know we're produced by machines, but knowing it and seeing it are two very different things.

lines.speaker: cecil
lines.text: Sure. I understand.

lines.speaker: papillon
lines.text: Call me if you need help, okay?

lines.speaker: cecil
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: papillon
lines.text: Hey, Cecil. Snap out of it. If your head's not in the game, Eden is doomed.

lines.speaker: cecil
lines.text: ... Will do. Thank you.
Papillon opens the door and steps outside.
Cecil quietly stares at the monitor connected to the body maker.
All the readings are normal. There are no signs of abnormalities.
She turns her eyes away from the screen and gazes at the brain shelters of Scarlet and Noah.

lines.speaker: rapunzel
lines.text: It's been a while.

lines.speaker: redshoes
lines.text: Yeah, it has.

lines.speaker: rapunzel
lines.text: This must be a space generated from NIMPH data.

lines.speaker: redshoes
lines.text: That's right.

lines.speaker: rapunzel
lines.text: The fact that you and I are together in this space,

lines.speaker: rapunzel
lines.text: means that you have infiltrated my NIMPH.

lines.speaker: redshoes
lines.text: That's also correct. You're amazing.

lines.speaker: rapunzel
lines.text: How are you even in here?

lines.speaker: redshoes
lines.text: Because they're currently trying to transplant my weapon onto you.

lines.speaker: rapunzel
lines.text: ... Red Shoes?

lines.speaker: redshoes
lines.text: That's right.

lines.speaker: redshoes
lines.text: That's how my personality data, hidden deep within the weapon, was able to infiltrate your NIMPH.

lines.speaker: rapunzel
lines.text: Ah, I see. It's personality data.

lines.speaker: rapunzel
lines.text: Did you leave it behind because you had some final words for me?

lines.speaker: rapunzel
lines.text: Whatever it is, you can tell me. I promise to pass it on to everyone, to the entire world.

lines.speaker: redshoes
lines.text: No, there's no need for that.

lines.speaker: redshoes
lines.text: After all, I'm going to be living within your NIMPH from now on.

lines.speaker: rapunzel
lines.text: ... What do you mean?

lines.speaker: redshoes
lines.text: I've waited so long,

lines.speaker: redshoes
lines.text: wondering who would eventually wield this weapon.

lines.speaker: redshoes
lines.text: I'd expected the new owner to be more than an ordinary Nikke, given that it's a second-generation Grimms model,

lines.speaker: redshoes
lines.text: but I never thought it would be someone of your caliber. It's quite the happy miscalculation on my part.

lines.speaker: redshoes
lines.text: I really am lucky to be receiving such a perfect vessel...

lines.speaker: rapunzel
lines.text: ... Are you trying to take over my NIMPH using the personality data embedded in your weapon?

lines.speaker: redshoes
lines.text: That's right.

lines.speaker: rapunzel
lines.text: How is that even possible?

lines.speaker: redshoes
lines.text: My personality data has a corruption mechanism within it.

lines.speaker: redshoes
lines.text: Eventually, you will succumb to corruption.

lines.speaker: redshoes
lines.text: But you won't become a Rapture. Instead, you'll become me.

lines.speaker: redshoes
lines.text: The fact that you're conversing with my personality data right now means the corruption has already taken root.

lines.speaker: redshoes
lines.text: Thank you, Rapunzel, for giving me such a perfect body. You really are generous.

lines.speaker: rapunzel
lines.text: You're saying that once I succumb to the corruption,

lines.speaker: rapunzel
lines.text: my mind won't become like a Rapture's, but rather like yours?

lines.speaker: redshoes
lines.text: That's right. You catch on quick.

lines.speaker: rapunzel
lines.text: Because you modified your personality data to become a form of corruption?

lines.speaker: redshoes
lines.text: Yup, yup. I hate to repeat myself, but you're really amazing.

lines.speaker: rapunzel
lines.text: What do you intend to do with my body?

lines.speaker: redshoes
lines.text: This time, at long last,

lines.speaker: redshoes
lines.text: I want to become a Heretic.

lines.speaker: redshoes
lines.text: With such a wonderful body, I'm sure the Raptures will welcome me with open arms.

lines.speaker: rapunzel
lines.text: Red Shoes.

lines.speaker: rapunzel
lines.text: Are you the one who created this corruption?

lines.speaker: redshoes
lines.text: Yeah, although it's more accurate to say I cultivated it.

lines.speaker: rapunzel
lines.text: I see. So you inserted your personality data into the Raptures' corruption technology that targets NIMPH.

lines.speaker: rapunzel
lines.text: That allows you to think "voluntarily," at least by Rapture standards.

lines.speaker: redshoes
lines.text: ... Again, that's amazing. You figured that all out so quickly.

lines.speaker: rapunzel
lines.text: I researched corruption for a long time.

lines.speaker: rapunzel
lines.text: I tried long and hard to pinpoint the source of it.

lines.speaker: rapunzel
lines.text: But there was a point where it achieved an inexplicable evolutionary leap forward.

lines.speaker: rapunzel
lines.text: A point where it jumped from only paralyzing Nikkes temporarily to suddenly making them think like Raptures.

lines.speaker: rapunzel
lines.text: It was such an unusual progression that I always suspected there must have been a catalyst,

lines.speaker: rapunzel
lines.text: or some external intervention.

lines.speaker: rapunzel
lines.text: That was you, wasn't it?

lines.speaker: redshoes
lines.text: That's right.

lines.speaker: rapunzel
lines.text: Why?

lines.speaker: redshoes
lines.text: Because joining forces with the Raptures is the only way to win this war.

lines.speaker: redshoes
lines.text: If we can achieve actual unity, then victory and defeat won't matter anymore.

lines.speaker: rapunzel
lines.text: ... So you're an apostate.

lines.speaker: redshoes
lines.text: "Apostate" is just a label that people in power use to eliminate anyone who stands against them.

lines.speaker: redshoes
lines.text: The world belongs to Raptures.

lines.speaker: redshoes
lines.text: If you really want to draw lines in the sand, it's you who are the apostates.

lines.speaker: redshoes
lines.text: Hmm. This is taking longer than I thought it would.

lines.speaker: redshoes
lines.text: I guess the NIMPH of someone as extraordinary as you is unusually sturdy.

lines.speaker: rapunzel
lines.text: Thank you for the compliment.

lines.speaker: redshoes
lines.text: You're welcome.

lines.speaker: rapunzel
lines.text: Also...

lines.speaker: rapunzel
lines.text: Thank you for providing such valuable information.

lines.speaker: redshoes
lines.text: Hehe, you're really gentle, huh?

lines.speaker: redshoes
lines.text: I'd been hoping to see you get upset, but not anymore.

lines.speaker: rapunzel
lines.text: One last thing.

lines.speaker: rapunzel
lines.text: I had been missing just one last thing.

lines.speaker: rapunzel
lines.text: I didn't know what caused the corruption's sudden evolutionary leap.

lines.speaker: rapunzel
lines.text: It was the last piece of the puzzle that I needed to conquer corruption.

lines.speaker: rapunzel
lines.text: All of the code from the point where that evolutionary jump occurred was indecipherable.

lines.speaker: rapunzel
lines.text: It was the only part I couldn't make sense of.

lines.speaker: rapunzel
lines.text: But now that I know the corruption was modified by a person, I can put it together.

lines.speaker: rapunzel
lines.text: If I proceed under the framework of that indecipherable code being the result of human interference,

lines.speaker: rapunzel
lines.text: I can find the answer.

lines.speaker: redshoes
lines.text: Congratulations.

lines.speaker: redshoes
lines.text: You found the answer right at the end of your life. How touching.

lines.speaker: rapunzel
lines.text: I am very grateful.

lines.speaker: rapunzel
lines.text: You gave me such a wonderful gift.

lines.speaker: redshoes
lines.text: ... What's going on? Something's wrong with this space...

lines.speaker: rapunzel
lines.text: There is something I should tell you.

lines.speaker: rapunzel
lines.text: I carry the NIMPH of countless others within me.

lines.speaker: rapunzel
lines.text: The space where you and I stand was not created by my NIMPH.

lines.speaker: rapunzel
lines.text: It was created by the NIMPH of my fellow sisters who are with me, now resting in eternal slumber.

lines.speaker: rapunzel
lines.text: The NIMPH you have been attempting to corrupt is theirs.

lines.speaker: rapunzel
lines.text: They are buying me time so I can have this conversation with you.

lines.speaker: rapunzel
lines.text: I suppose you could call it a... bait-and-switch? A decoy? Something along those lines.

lines.speaker: rapunzel
lines.text: I would hate to trouble their NIMPH any further, so I think I'll end our conversation here.

lines.speaker: rapunzel
lines.text: NIMPH resists corruption on a fundamental level.

lines.speaker: rapunzel
lines.text: You can see this from how early-stage corruption heals naturally.

lines.speaker: rapunzel
lines.text: The reason Nikkes succumb to corruption is because it overwhelms the NIMPH's data capacity,

lines.speaker: rapunzel
lines.text: essentially outweighing and crushing it.

lines.speaker: rapunzel
lines.text: Since there is a limit to the amount of NIMPH data that can be loaded onto a single Nikke, it is impossible to outclass the corruption.

lines.speaker: redshoes
lines.text: ... Rapunzel, wait.
Golden particles begin to ripple throughout the space.
Soon, everything is dyed gold.

lines.speaker: rapunzel
lines.text: Fortunately, I carry the NIMPH of my sisters,

lines.speaker: rapunzel
lines.text: a full twelve-thousand who have passed into eternal slumber.

lines.speaker: rapunzel
lines.text: I will never fall to something like corruption.

lines.speaker: redshoes
lines.text: Wait, just listen to what I have to say. I—

lines.speaker: rapunzel
lines.text: Modifying your personality data into a form of corruption was a mistake, Red Shoes.

lines.speaker: rapunzel
lines.text: I know you did so in order to steal my body,

lines.speaker: rapunzel
lines.text: but it ended up backfiring on you.

lines.speaker: redshoes
lines.text: I'm begging you, please spare me.

lines.speaker: rapunzel
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: rapunzel
lines.text: I cannot forgive you.
The gold permeating the space starts to swallow any trace of red.
Red Shoes struggles frantically,
but the sacred gold hue shows no mercy.
Eventually,
only the golden light and Rapunzel remain.
Cecil peers into the monitor connected to Rapunzel's body maker.
She thought she detected a brief anomaly, but now there is nothing unusual.

lines.speaker: cecil
lines.text: I must be nervous. This isn't like me.
Cecil turns her gaze to another monitor.
The screen is filled with Scarlet and Rose's data.
She shifts her eyes to her personal PC,
and stares at the numerous formulas and notes on the screen.
She suddenly feels a sharp ache in her head.

lines.speaker: cecil
lines.text: ... Is there really no way...?
Cecil stands there silently for a moment.
She looks at the other body maker.
Then she looks at the two brain shelters.
She hesitantly stretches forth her hand.
As she reaches for Noah's brain shelter,
she suddenly stops as she feels a chilling sensation behind her.
Cecil hastily turns around.
Rose is staring at her.
